name: chat-organizer
description: Organize chats, projects and sidebar sections in Codex desktop.

interface.longDescription: Find projectless chats, preview a sidebar cleanup and organize chats and projects with the built-in Codex desktop actions. Group chats in sections, move them between projects, pin, rename, archive or restore them.
defaultPrompt: Find my projectless Codex chats and suggest where they belong.
Preview a cleanup of my sidebar.
Help me group related chats in a sidebar section.
